messages:
Ari: FYI CI bounced on the samplekit regen step — regendiff shows only ordering noise but it tripped the publish gate.
Lena: can you paste the regendiff snippet? hoping it's not a real schema change.
Ari: sure, here's the relevant chunk:
```
- components/schemas/Session.yaml
- components/schemas/User.yaml
+ components/schemas/User.yaml
+ components/schemas/Session.yaml
```
Ari: plus a flaky test in the sample app toggles the default retry policy during one path, so typegen picks up a default change on rerun.
regen-bot: job #9824 regendiff: 2 files changed (ordering-only), 1 file changed (content: tests/sample-auth-retries.js). deterministic: false
Sam: seems like two independent flakes: OpenAPI parse ordering and a test that doesn't fully teardown. short-term we should suppress ordering-only diffs from causing semver bumps.
Lena: agreed. I can add a comparator to the typegen serializer to sort object keys deterministically. easier to ship quickly than chasing parser upstream.
Ari: for CI hotfix, can we add a `--deterministic-keys` flag to the regen script and set it in CI?
Sam: yeah add the flag for now. i'll also update the release gating rule to ignore diffs where the only changes are ordering.
Lena: i reproduced locally: run `NODE_ENV=ci yarn regen:samplekit` toggles the files. with `--deterministic-keys` it's stable. i'll open a PR that adds a unit asserting stable order to avoid regressions.
Ari: which test was mutating global retry? can you point me to it so i can revert it quickly?
Lena: tests/sample-auth-retries.js has a beforeEach that sets global.retryPolicy = {tries: 3} but one test throws before afterEach runs. i'll patch to use a sandboxed copy instead.
Sam: timeline? we need publish window in ~2 hours.
Ari: can you push the CI flag change now and make release-gate ignore ordering-only? i'll draft docs note.
Sam: done — added `--deterministic-keys` to CI regen job and updated release-gate to treat ordering-only as no-semver. Pushed branch regen-hotfix/ci-flag.
ci-bot: build #9825: regen job re-run -> PASSED (no regendiff)
Ari: great. Lena, please include the test teardown fix and the stable-order unit test in a follow-up PR.
Lena: PR #512 opened with test fix + stable-order unit + small changelog note.
regen-bot: PR scan: changelog entry detected. semver impact: none.
Sam: merged the CI flag and gate changes, will follow up with a ticket to upstream parser for deterministic ordering.
Ari: adding a short note in the onboarding checklist docs: "If regen diffs appear on first run, re-run with `--deterministic-keys` and file an issue."
Lena: local verification steps I used:
1) checkout branch
2) `yarn install`
3) `NODE_ENV=ci yarn regen:samplekit`
4) `git status` should be clean with flag
Ari: CI is green on the hotfix run. thanks all, leaving thread open until PR merges.
ci-bot: build #9830: all samplekit jobs PASSED
Ari: closing — thanks everyone :party:
